chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 237 — The Great Derivative & Puppet Canon
chapter_meta_description: Han Li uncovers the Great Derivative Art and the Puppet Daoist Canon in a single jade slip. A quiet victory phase begins as he weighs the cost of mastering puppetry against his Core Formation hopes.
og_description: Han Li finds the legendary Great Derivative Art and Puppet Daoist Canon. But mastering them could cost him his chance at Core Formation. The quiet victory phase has arrived.
twitter_description: Han Li uncovers a paired cultivation technique that could make him a puppet master—but at what cost? New chapter up!

lore_anchors.definition: A secret technique that strengthens the cultivator's divine sense, allowing them to split their consciousness to control multiple puppets or magical tools independently. Locked translation.
A comprehensive manual covering the methods to refine puppets and mechanical beasts of every grade. Considered the "authentic interpretation" of puppet-crafting lore.
A speed-focused flying artifact refined from Ink Flood Dragon fin and tail. Extremely fast but lacks defensive capabilities and passenger capacity. Locked translation.
Li Huayuan’s cave dwelling, hidden behind a massive waterfall in a secluded valley filled with exotic fauna.
A one-use talisman that carries a spoken message to a pre-set recipient, typically used to announce one's arrival at a guarded location.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Great Derivative Art the same technique as what the Thousand Bamboo School used?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes. The Thousand Bamboo School’s foundational secret art for strengthening divine sense and enabling the Soul Divide technique is the Great Derivative Art. Han Li found it among Senior Brother Lin’s belongings.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Han Li just learn both the Great Derivative Art and the Puppet Daoist Canon right away?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because doing so would consume time and energy he needs for his personal cultivation, which could ruin his already slim chance at Core Formation. He shelves the decision to weigh the cost.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who is the mistress mentioned in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She is Li Huayuan’s wife, a mid-Foundation Establishment cultivator. She keeps the valley full of exotic little animals and is described as gentle and warm—a rare figure of genuine kindness in the Mortal Stream.
